data.narrative:
Blue Water Autonomy, founded by Rylan Hamilton and Austin Gray, is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $64M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $64M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding $128M. Peer-median analysis benchmarks against 11 Defense & Security peers at Series B and adjacent stages, with a median valuation of $1.0B and a range spanning $125M to $3.0B. Sample peers include Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

Triangulation across these two methods supports a valuation range of $109M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $564M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around Blue Water Autonomy's relative position within the Defense & Security peer cohort. Key variables affecting final valuation include revenue trajectory, customer concentration, technology defensibility, and market adoption rates—factors not fully captured in stage and peer-median approaches alone.
